method: Every baseline record received canonical-site, identity/field and adverse-evidence review. reviewedFields is the baseline reviewed (proposed values for additions); changes records supported corrections and removals. Retained means reasonably carried forward with the specific uncertainties below, not independently re-proven. Omitted filters are not claims of product absence. Search/discovery leads are not confirmed findings. All security checks use checkedOn above; event dates and affected surfaces appear in each finding. No exploit reproduction or live-funds test. No safety certification.
